Ñawu waylaama on hokki laawol Laamu Hindiya ngam nasta e hoodere ɗe ñawu on fiyi masin, ngam jeyaade ko ɓesdi: ƴetta ɓurɗi ngam ƴeewtugo e maɓɓude ɓurɗi, yeeso hoɓɓe ɓee, soosta kaaɗe pelle ɗiɗi ɗe ngonndi ngam mbaawɗi, e ɗon ndifa safaara ngam waaɗe ɓii mbaawɗi.

Sorry, that output is not reliable. Here is a cleaner version:

Ñawu pekkere on wallitii laamu Hindu on ngam jeyaade ko ɓesdi, ko wayi no yaadugo e ƴeewtugo e hooreeji ɓurɗi ɗe e ɓuuɓri, yeeso lesdi ɗi ñawu on fiyi masin, hokkugo ɗuuɗal njaaɓaaji sulfi, e ndiyugo safaara ngam waaɗe ɓii.
